content_of_post_to_comment: Seriously it makes sense if you think the idea itself makes sense. The law of attraction and the universe wanting balance. I just blew my mind but then I thought what's next? Are we going to manifest something else!? This is just an idea, I am not saying it is true but it is interesting in my opinion.
comment: I think the fascinating part is how the idea of “balance” can be interpreted in different ways. Some people see it as the universe correcting things, while others see it as our own actions and mindset shaping what we notice and pursue. Either way, it raises an interesting question about whether we’re discovering patterns or creating them.
